composition.candidate_inclusion_source: pair_records reconstructed at pre_score_eligible_v1, reconciled to native_pair_keys
composition.candidate_count_source: count of unique candidate keys in C_e for event e
composition.pair_row_reconciliation_rule: for every native_pair_key, exactly one pair_records row with identical stable key must exist when overflow counters are zero; otherwise the capture is partial and fail-closed
composition.overflow_rule: any overflow_* counter > 0 invalidates completeness for the affected stream and fail-closes universe sealing for that capture
composition.truncation_rule: silent truncation is forbidden; truncated rows must surface as overflow counters

future_producer_must_prove: all native candidates satisfying inclusion semantics are represented
no candidate row is silently dropped
reported total reconciles with emitted rows
each candidate belongs to exactly one event
